label: Mythical creatures
blurb: The folk of myth and fairy tale: merfolk, fairies, trolls, orcs, goblins, centaurs, satyrs, minotaurs, dryads, harpies, naga, gorgons and the high fae, living side by side in an enchanted wildwood.
context: mythical creature character from myth and fairy tale (not a plain human), in an enchanted wildwood

fairy.label: Fairy
fairy.features: delicate translucent dragonfly-like wings at the back, slightly pointed ears and a faint shimmer of glittering dust on the skin

merfolk.label: Merfolk
merfolk.features: a long shimmering scaled fish tail in place of legs, delicate fin-like ears and iridescent scales along the cheekbones, neck and shoulders

troll.label: Troll
troll.features: a long drooping nose, large pointed ears, a jutting underbite with small tusks, thick warty hide and huge knobbly hands

orc.label: Orc
orc.features: prominent lower tusks, a heavy brow, pointed ears and a powerful frame

goblin.label: Goblin
goblin.features: a small wiry frame, long pointed ears, a sharp hooked nose and a grin full of little pointed teeth

centaur.label: Centaur
centaur.features: a human upper body and face on the four-legged body of a horse, with a long flowing horse tail

satyr.label: Satyr
satyr.features: small curling goat horns, pointed goat-like ears, shaggy goat legs ending in cloven hooves and a short tail

minotaur.label: Minotaur
minotaur.features: a bull's head in place of a human face: a broad furred bovine muzzle with a flat wet nose and a brass nose ring, floppy bull ears and two large curved horns, on a powerful fur-covered human-like body
minotaur.hair: short coarse fur between the horns

dryad.label: Dryad
dryad.features: bark-textured skin on the arms and shoulders, and leaves and small blossoms growing through the hair

harpy.label: Harpy
harpy.features: large feathered wings in place of arms, taloned bird feet and feathers along the neck and shoulders

naga.label: Naga
naga.features: a human upper body on a long scaled serpent tail in place of legs, with scales along the arms and cheekbones

gorgon.label: Gorgon
gorgon.features: fine scales along the cheekbones and neck
gorgon.hair: a writhing crown of living green snakes in place of hair

highfae.label: High fae
highfae.features: long sharply pointed ears, an ageless otherworldly face, faint glowing markings at the temples and a thin circlet of antler-like horns

hobbies: collecting shiny things from the riverbed
dancing in fairy rings under the full moon
singing to the sea at dusk
wrestling in the mud for fun
racing the wind across the hills
listening to the gossip of birds
quirks: speaking only in rhymes when excited
keeping a pocket full of pebbles
flinching at the sound of iron bells
goals: getting back the true name a human stole
earning a seat at the Seelie court
guarding the old bridge for a thousand years
finding the lost song of {poss} people
making peace between the forest and the sea
building the grandest hoard in the hills
being accepted by the humans in the valley
seeing the ocean from the top of the world
finding a cure for the blight in the old forest
being remembered in a bard's song
accessories: a necklace of shells and sea glass
a bone-handled knife at the belt
a pouch of shiny stolen trinkets
a lantern with a trapped glowing wisp
a crooked wooden staff wound with ivy
a string of teeth and beads
a pan pipe on a cord
an acorn-cap charm on a cord
a small hand mirror of polished silver
default_outfits: a simple tunic of woven leaves and bark with a rope belt
a rough-spun wrap of moss-coloured cloth, a leather belt and bare feet
a patched cloak of feathers and fur over a plain tunic
_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): no modern eyewear or dye, and marks that suit any of the races. Races with a body plan other than two legs (merfolk, centaur, naga) state it in 'morphology', so full-body batches skip them (see npcgen/morphology.py). Outfits avoid shoes where hooves, tails or talons would be.

glasses.label: a pair of tiny round spectacles

facial_hair.label: a beard of moss and lichen

distinguishing.label: glowing rune markings on the shoulders
a torn ear from an old fight
heterochromia, one eye a different colour from the other
tribal war paint across the eyes
tiny mushrooms growing on the shoulder
a faint silver glow around the skin
